methodologyNotes: Re-verified via WebFetch on official pricing pages on 2026-06-18: codacy.com/pricing, deepsource.com/pricing, sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing, codescene.com/pricing. embold.io/pricing returned HTTP 502 (unreachable); Embold plan structure supplemented via WebSearch (G2/SaaSworthy, last updated June 2025) and Premium price left null because no official source confirms a number. Key correction: DeepSource Team has a real monthly rate of $30/user/month (the draft incorrectly stored the $24 annual-equivalent as monthlyUsd). CodeScene prices are published in EUR (numbers stored as published monthly EUR; no official USD list price exists) and CodeScene offers a 14-day trial. Codiga remains excluded (discontinued/acquired by Datadog 2023). Enterprise/custom plans with no published price are monthlyUsd:null. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Codacy
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from codacy.com/pricing on 2026-06-18: Developer $0/dev forever, Team $21/dev/mo monthly or $18/dev/mo annual (14-day trial, no card), Business custom. SOC2 Type 2 and GDPR confirmed on codacy.com/security; HIPAA not mentioned (null).

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free forever for individual developers. IDE plugin (VS Code, JetBrains, Cursor), real-time feedback, AI guardrails, security/quality scans (SAST, SCA, secrets), auto-fix. No private repo integrations.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $21/dev/month billed monthly, $18/dev/month billed annually (~14% off). Up to 30 developers, up to 100 private repos (unlimited LOC), GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab Cloud, AI Reviewer, merge gates, 49 languages, coverage reports, malicious package detection, Jira + Slack. Free for open-source. 14-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. For orgs exceeding 30 developers or 100 private projects. Unlimited private projects, daily CVE re-scans, AI Inventory, AI Risk Hub, license scanning, DAST, container scanning, SSO/SAML, audit logs, dedicated CSM, premium support.

limits: Team plan: up to 100 private repos
keyFeatures: Real-time IDE feedback with AI guardrails
enrichment.provenance: Plans/limits from codacy.com/pricing; SOC2 Type 2 and GDPR confirmed on codacy.com/security; HIPAA not stated.

vendors.name: DeepSource
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from deepsource.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. CORRECTED: Team has a published monthly rate of $30/user/month; $24/user/month is the annual-billing price (~20% savings). Draft wrongly stored $24 as monthlyUsd and claimed no monthly rate exists. SOC2 Type II confirmed via deepsource.com/blog/soc2; GDPR not explicitly confirmed (null).

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Free for unlimited public repositories. 1,000 pull requests reviewed monthly, 1,000 code formatting runs/month. Pay-as-you-go AI Review and Autofix credits available.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $30/user/month billed monthly; $24/user/month billed annually (~20% savings). Unlimited repos and PR reviews, unlimited code formatting, bundled AI Review credit ($10/user/mo monthly or $100/user/yr annual). AI Review add-on: $8/10K LOC (Standard) or $15/10K LOC (Advanced). 14-day free trial with up to $50 bundled AI Review credits.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. All Team features plus self-hosted deployment, BYOK for AI Review, SSO, SLA-backed priority support, manual invoicing, dedicated account manager, migration assistance, volume discounts.

limits: Open Source plan: public repos only
Team AI Review credits: bundled then pay-as-you-go
keyFeatures: AI-powered code review with credit-based billing
enrichment.provenance: Plan details from deepsource.com/pricing (Team monthly $30 corrected from draft's $24 annual figure); SOC2 Type II from DeepSource blog (May 2022); GDPR not confirmed.

vendors.name: SonarQube Cloud (Sonar)
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing on 2026-06-18. SonarCloud rebranded to SonarQube Cloud. Free (50k LOC private, 5 users; unlimited public). Team starts at $32/mo for 100k LOC, scales to 1.9M LOC. Enterprise custom (from 5M LOC). SOC2 and GDPR cited from sonarsource.com/trust-center.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 50,000 LOC for private projects, up to 5 users. Unlimited public/open-source project scanning with no LOC restriction. Community support only.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Starts at $32/month for 100k LOC; scales up to 1.9M LOC (higher LOC tiers priced incrementally). Unlimited users. 30+ languages, bug/vulnerability detection, secrets detection, AI-driven fixes, PR analysis. Billed monthly via credit card. Recommended for teams under 50 developers.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom annual pricing, starting from 5M LOC. Unlimited users/projects, 40+ languages incl. ABAP/COBOL/Apex, SSO/SCIM/CMK/BYOK, IP allowlist, advanced security reports and audit logs, OWASP/CWE/PCI DSS/MISRA compliance reporting, portfolios, dedicated SLA.

limits: Public-repo OSS analysis unlimited but no private projects on free public-only path
enrichment.provenance: Plan data from sonarsource.com/plans-and-pricing (Team $32/mo confirmed). SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 cited from sonarsource.com/trust-center; GDPR via Sonar trust documentation. The official pricing page itself does not enumerate SOC2/GDPR badges.

vendors.name: CodeScene
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from codescene.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Prices published in EUR: Standard €20/author/mo monthly or €18 annual; Pro €30/author/mo monthly or €27 annual (10% annual savings). Free Community/OSS tier plus a 14-day free trial for Standard/Pro (codescene.com/product/free-trial). ISO 27001 certified; GDPR via policies. SOC2 not stated (null).

plans.name: Community (Open Source)
plans.notes: Free forever for open-source projects. Automated PR code reviews, technical debt management, Code Health measurement, knowledge distribution visualization, PDF reports, virtual code reviews, customizable Code Health rules.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Published in EUR: €20/active author/month (monthly) or €18/active author/month (annual, 10% savings). Unlimited private repos, technical debt management, Code Health analysis, knowledge distribution, quality gates for AI coding, automated code review, 30+ languages, IDE Code Health Monitor. 'Active author' = anyone who committed code in past 3 months. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Published in EUR: €30/active author/month (monthly) or €27/active author/month (annual, 10% savings). All Standard features plus Software Portfolio overview, team insights, delivery insights, code coverage measurement. Monthly cancels anytime; yearly requires 30 days notice. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. All Pro features plus scalable pricing, dedicated workshops, tailored onboarding and support. On-premise deployment option available.

limits: Paid plans priced per 'active author' (committed code in past 3 months)
Each author counted once across all repos
Prices published in EUR, not USD
keyFeatures: Behavioral code analysis (hotspot detection via git history)
Code Health metric for technical debt prioritization
enrichment.provenance: Plan prices from codescene.com/pricing (EUR as published; per-author licensing). 14-day trial confirmed via codescene.com/product/free-trial. GDPR and ISO 27001 from codescene.com/policies; SOC2 not stated (null).
